note: File: studies/rlneurons/results/wrongstep/math500-01/items.json (in git; 51 items, all carry base/code31/math31 with float lp_span and lp_control, so no drops are expected). D uses whole-span summed log-probs, as the recipe says (same definition as metrics.json D.all). n = 51, so T = floor(51/3) = 17 items; n reported = 17 (the smaller group), groups line gives 17 and 51. Ties sorted by (D_math31, problem_index, sample). Other reading (alt_measured): the share of Code 3.1's lowering only, i.e. the same ratio with each D_code31 replaced by min(D_code31, 0), since 'lowering' could mean the negative part rather than the signed sum. In the signed reading positive D_code31 items outside T shrink the denominator and can push C above 1. Bootstrap resamples items (with replacement), re-sorts and re-takes floor(n/3) each time; a resample with denominator >= 0 is set to -inf (undefined counts as refuted). C can be unstable because the denominator is a sum of mixed-sign numbers.

Same file. Labels present: slip, misread, wrong_plan; 'plan' matches only wrong_plan (16 items per metrics.json). D_code31 = (lp_span - lp_control)_code31 - (lp_span - lp_control)_base, whole-span sums. n = number of kept items. Bootstrap over the kept items. Other reading (alt_measured): the same mean using the head-5-token fields lp_head / lp_head_control instead of the whole span, since result-faf15a also reports a head-5-tokens D. metrics.json already holds a stored code31 wrong_plan mean, which the script does not read; the script recomputes from items.

File: studies/rlneurons/results/axis/math500-01/vectors.json (in git; 500 problems, v3 0/1 vectors per arm). Arms base_cue_s0..s3 and code_cue (Code-RL 3.1 cue). Z = positions where the four base_cue samples sum to 0; null/missing entries count as 0 (none were seen in a format check). Statistic = mean code_cue over Z, n = |Z|, bootstrap over Z positions. Recipe is unambiguous so alt_measured is None. Caveat: code_cue is one sample, and Z is chosen by the same base samples, so it includes problems where the base can solve the problem but missed 4 times (selection on base failure), which pushes the rate up relative to a fresh base sample.
